What's this?

Spotify Downloader is an online tool that lets you download Spotify tracks as 320kbps MP3 for free. Playlists & albums can be downloaded as ZIP. No need to have a Spotify account or register anywhere. Simply enter the track or playlist link and hit sumbit and Spotify Downloader will download everything for you within a few clicks. Saved MP3 files also have all the metadata associated with them (cover art, release year, album, etc).

Note: We don't host any user content or media on our servers. We use third parties to serve content. All copyright belongs to respective copyright owners.

Features:
Download any Spotify track as 320kbps MP3.
Download Spotify playlists & albums as a single compressed ZIP archive.
Audio files have all the metadata in them: Cover art, release year, artists, album, etc.
No limits. Download as many Spotify tracks as you desire.
High quality & high speed download.
No login or Spotify account required.
Completely free. No need to buy any type of subscription.
How to use?
Open your Spotify app.
Find the track, album or playlist you would like to download.
Click the "3 dots".
Select "Share" and click "Copy link".
Paste the link above and click "Search".
Wait for Spotify Downloader to process.
Click "Download" button below a track you would like to download.
Click "Download ZIP" to download the entire playlist as a single compressed ZIP archive.
Enjoy & keep repeating :)

 
Frequently Asked Questions:
Do I need a Spotify account?

No, Spotify Downloader lets you download any Spotify track without needing to register anywhere.

What is the file format?

Our tool downloads all audio files as MP3. MP3 is the most widely used audio format. Playlists & Albums are saved as ZIP.

Can I download Spotify playlists?

Yes, Spotify Downloader can download entire playlists & albums as a single ZIP file.
